platform.title: Platform Engineering
platform.description: Build internal platforms, golden paths, and self-service tooling that let product teams ship safely and quickly.
platform.audience: For DevOps, SRE, and backend engineers who want to improve developer experience across many teams.
platform.goal: Design and operate a self-service platform that treats developers as customers and measures its impact.

relatedTracks.reason: Containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code

levels.goal: Understand what a platform is and how developers experience it.

skills.name: Platform Engineering Fundamentals
skills.description: Learn how platform teams differ from DevOps and SRE and what an internal developer platform provides.
outcomes: Explain platform engineering, DevOps, and SRE and where they overlap
Describe the parts of an internal developer platform
Identify developer pain points worth solving first
